static_checks.javascript_syntax: pass for embedded renderer and application scripts

browser.execution_method: Chromium 144 under Xvfb using the exact inline HTML through page.set_content because managed policy blocks file:// and localhost navigation

performance.measurement_note: SwiftShader validates correctness but is not evidence of discrete-GPU FPS. The runtime performance guard lowers scene resolution with hysteresis below the target frame rate.

hardening_fixes: Removed all CDN and ES-module loading paths and embedded the complete renderer.
Moved resolutionScale initialization ahead of parameter-store callbacks to remove the temporal-dead-zone failure.
Closed the dust vertex shader main function; browser shader compilation now reports zero errors.
Added explicit runtime readiness and deterministic destroy cleanup markers.
limitations: Managed Chromium policy prevented direct file:// navigation, so the exact HTML source was executed with page.set_content; the delivered build uses only classic inline scripts and has no local-file module/CORS dependency.
Measured FPS is from software WebGL and must not be interpreted as a target desktop GPU benchmark.
